contests.name: NFL $2.5M Fantasy Football Millionaire [$1M to 1st, $50K Crown Cash Throne Eligible]

experimental.why: the first-place estimate rests on the field sample's extreme tail: with 300,000 sampled lineups against 147,058 entries, one sampled lineup stands for 0.5 entries and the smallest mass the sample can report is 1 in 300,000. Ties are paid the way DraftKings pays them (Stage 3B). The duplicate count is still measured rather than derived: an exact path-summed construction probability now exists for a fixed lineup (dfs_pathprob), but against three million draws it runs about 5% light at the median with one lineup 2.8 standard errors low, so the undercount is neither resolved nor bounded and this link stays shut. Resolution and duplication are what keep these columns experimental. Rank on top 1% and top 0.1%. The lists' own first-place and EV figures are selection-inflated too: valued on fresh worlds against a 1.2M-lineup field, week 1's top-20 win list held about a quarter of its shown first-place rate and the EV list about a third at 40,000 worlds, a third and under half at 160,000 (research/reports/cl_worlds.md).

field_model.kind: sampled: softmax on projection and price, stack and bring-back rates from the public record
field_model.note: the field is a sample of the public's builds: stack rates from Establish The Run's Milly Maker record, sharpness set so the most-owned player sits at 38%. Dollar figures assume the sim is the truth; read the ranks. Each player's ownership is then steered to 90% of his share of the simulated Sundays' best lineups plus 10% of that calibrated share: on three real Millionaires the public drafted closer to the best-lineup share than to the calibrated one.

matchup.reason: the pre-registered test shipped no DFS adjustment (weight 0)

last_attempt.why: no contest of $1,000,000+ with a payout table and a field size

payout.ev_notie: the same expected payout with ties ignored, for the size of the difference
payout.ties: DraftKings splits the tied positions' prizes equally; ev pays that rule over the distribution of how many finish above and level (dfs_tourney.tie_payout)
payout.win_any_pct: first or a share of it

contest.name: NFL $2.5M Fantasy Football Millionaire [$1M to 1st, $50K Crown Cash Throne Eligible]

rules: the quarterback is stacked with at least one of his receivers or tight ends (a back does not count; RB_STACK_TARGETS, a knob, decided after the simulator work)
no defense against our quarterback's team or our running backs' teams
at most 3 from one team; no cap on players from one game (CL_MAX_PER_GAME, a knob, decided after the simulator work)
at most one punt under $3,000, and he must hold a role (RB1-2, WR1-3, TE1)
roster gate: QB1, RB1-2, WR1-3, TE1-2 by Sleeper's depth chart; OUT/IR/doubtful out

simulator.dst: DraftKings DST scored off the same simulated game (points allowed by the other offence, sacks, takeaways, return TDs, safeties, blocks)
simulator.kicker: field goals by distance and tries off the same simulated game
simulator.marginals: not pinned: each player's mean is what the simulated game deals him

passing_volume.target: (1 - w) x the engine's own attempts + w x Sleeper's projected team attempts

simulator.projections: sleeper-weekly (usage shares), drive model + deep engine (team level)
simulator.touchdowns: the engine's, allocated among the men who caught (carried) the ball
